summary: All eight result images were read and scored from pixels; no result is missing, so status is PASS. Weighted totals (out of 100): P04-walking-teapot-2 97.5, P07-walking-teapot-2 96, P07-walking-teapot-1 94.5, P04-walking-teapot-1 93, P04-mountain-boat-2 90.5, P04-mountain-boat-1 88, P07-mountain-boat-1 87, P07-mountain-boat-2 83. Candidate means: P04 92.25, P07 90.1, so P04 ranks first by a narrow margin driven by the mountain-boat case, where P07-mountain-boat-2 added the most unsupported foothill scenery and P07-mountain-boat-1 showed a shading seam between peaks; on the teapot case the candidates are effectively tied. No severe geometry failures: every render keeps all major forms in place with correct counts and pose. Anchor verification: the teapot anchor note 'loop right side, open hole' is not supported by the sketch, which draws a closed solid pentagon with no inner contour; three of four teapot renders correctly kept it solid, while P04-walking-teapot-1 opened a hole and was docked for following the note over the pixels. The teapot 'circular eyes' note is loose (the sketch eyes are vertical ovals) and the 'smile' is a V chevron; all renders matched the ovals and chevron. Mountain-boat anchors (left peak tallest, sun small upper right, waterline ~68% down, right-pointing sail on vertical mast) are supported by the sketch and honoured by all four renders. Common deviations across all boat renders: hull raised ~4-5% above its drawn position and forest/cloud scenery inserted into the empty band between mountain bases and waterline; suns enlarged with glow halos. Uncertainties: positions are estimated by eye from the side-by-side composites at reduced resolution (about 500x757 per panel), so placement figures carry roughly +/-2% error; I cannot verify provenance or that each image was produced by the stated prompt, only what the pixels show; the two repeats per candidate are too few to separate prompt effect from sampling variance, and the P04/P07 gap on mountain-boat is within that noise.
